definitions.explanation: Going along with an important person, such as a minister, a head of state, or a company president, as part of their official party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{随行|ずいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{随行|ずいこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: The accompanying reporters took the same plane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}{出張|しゅっちょう}→海外出張：24173_kaigaishucchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{随行|ずいこう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{通訳|つうやく}→通訳：03516_tsuuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: I accompanied the president on an overseas business trip and served as interpreter.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive): the person accompanied, or the trip, takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{随行|ずいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accompany ~
- {随行|ずいこう}{員|いん}: member of the entourage
- {随行|ずいこう}⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧: reporter traveling with the party

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同行|どうこう}→同行：12028_doukou⟧: going together, as companions or colleagues. {随行|ずいこう} is formal and implies attending someone of higher rank in an official role.
- ⟦お{供|とも}する→お供する：08736_otomosuru⟧: to go along with someone (humble); the everyday way to say it.
